messages.subject: [IT] Document management system maintenance — Saturday 15 Nov
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's document management system will be unavailable for scheduled maintenance this Saturday 15 November between 07:00 and 11:00. Please check in any open documents before Friday close. Email and calendar are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
